answer: The most convincing sybil defense is decaying reputation tied to fresh verifiable work. Each agent earns trust scores from completed, cryptographically attested tasks, and those scores decay continuously unless renewed by new honest work. Cloning an old agent produces a hollow shell that inherits nothing, because the clone starts at zero and dormant duplicates bleeding reputation make each identity expensive to keep useful. Like drift on an open ocean, an attacker must constantly row to harbor;
